findings.title: Configuration lifetime ends before the ordered PWP replay
findings.evidence: configuration_live is assigned phase_active; row_last clears phase_active on last-row acceptance. M401 candidate_sample orders config, matcher, bitmap seal, tile DMA and only then tile0/tile1 replay. The independent VCS repro shows a correctly tagged replay low beat after the last row is rejected and raises sticky fault.
findings.repair: Decouple row_ingress_active from config_live. Add an explicit phase_release/phase_done handshake owned by the integration controller. Retain centers, bitmap and tag through bitmap seal, both M384 tile replays and adapter drain; permit the next config only after phase_release and all matcher/adapter state is idle.

findings.title: Aggregate shell protocol_error is not globally fail-closed
findings.evidence: shell_fault and adapter_error gate only the PWP adapter path. Matcher config/row/result ports are wired directly. The independent VCS repro observes result_valid and result_accept while aggregate protocol_error is already high; it also observes pwp_low_ready=1 with valid=1 but pwp_low_accept=0.
findings.repair: Create sticky global_fault and global_safe at the shell boundary. Gate every exported ready, valid and accept for config, row, result, PWP and contribution; derive accepts from the gated ready/valid pair; assert permanent quiescence after global_fault until reset.

findings.title: The q32/640-byte M384 patch still has no refreshed admission
findings.detail: Current RTL/SVA/TB hashes are 7a93b60b..., 214f41d4... and ba76fc27..., while existing M384 VCS and downstream Synopsys receipts bind the old 576-byte RTL hash 15f0e1d8.... M405r2 correctly leaves m384_q32_regression=false.

findings.title: Ready-high evidence isolates steady state with an external two-record prefill
findings.detail: This is compatible with the named M401 two-cycle tail only if an integrated M384-to-adapter miter confirms startup and mixed-width service introduce no further gaps.

findings.title: Directed q32 coverage is not the frozen real-population miter
findings.detail: Only 64 synthetic rows are checked; the frozen q32 centers and all 17,280 phase task counts have not been replayed through RTL.

findings.title: Directed codec coverage is not exhaustive
findings.detail: 386 synthetic blocks do not replace the required 442,368 block and 42,467,328 lane frozen codec replay.

findings.title: No physical or performance admission transfers
findings.detail: M401/M402 remains a 1.1563713549830412x four-Conv trace-cycle candidate. M405r2/M406 add no RTL-measured, system, energy, DC, Formality or PrimeTime claim.
